name: AI Data Generator with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Nano Banana 2, Ollama and LM Studio for WooCommerce
author: eMagicOne

sections.description:
AI Data Generator with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Nano Banana 2, Ollama and LM Studio for WooCommerce is a module intended to connect Store Manager software with OpenAI (ChatGPT), Google Gemini/Nano Banana2 or Anthropic Claude AI Models. Also models installed on local servers based on Ollama or LM Studio can be connected as well. Generate product and category content automatically with AI based on product data or images, create new products based on images with AI vision, generate or update images, use macros, free prompts and more.
Desktop application Store Manager for WooCommerce is a comprehensive solution with ever-increasing set of features that overcome and extend default back-end functionality.

Features

Generate WooCommerce product and category data with AI

  • Supported models: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and any model that can be installed on Ollama or LM Studio.
  • Generate missing product and category data like name, descriptions, meta data, and more.
  • Use built-in Macros features to add dynamic elements (like add manufacturer, brand, attributes, to generate content based on these data).
  • Append, prepend or replace existing data. The best solution is to append or prepend generated texts by LLM to the existing data from supplier / manufacturer. Or to rewrite existing generic descriptions provided by your supplier, making them unique.
  • Automatically translate product and category data into any language.
  • Make sure your content is professionally written, does not have any typos and grammar mistakes.

Use AI Vision

  • AI vision capabilities allow us to understand and analyze images, opening up exciting possibilities for multimodal interaction.
  • Supported models: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and any model that offers AI Vision and can be installed on LM Studio or Ollama.
  • Use AI vision to create WooCommerce products or generate product details based on image only.
  • Simply upload product images to the cloud or local folder (where Store Manager is pointing to) and WooCommerce products will be automatically created.
  • All required data can be automatically filled in, including product name, product description, price, etc.
  • Set other fields like quantity, availability, and other default fields.

Generate product image or update existing product image with AI

  • Supported models: Nano Banana, ChatGPT Images.
  • Generate image(s) based on existing product image, product name or any other field.
  • Automatically generate images name (if applicable), image alt, and title.
  • Replace existing image with a newly generated image or add new images to the gallery.
  • Update image by removing or blurring product image background, adjusting light, image size or color of the product.
  • Update image background. For example show the footwear on the beach sand/in the city or urban environment / in the mountain when hiking or on any specific model.
  • Change the season of the photo: change to winter / autumn season, etc.

Use AI PromptBook

  • Use promptbook with free prompts, update or create your own specific prompts. Find available prompts here.
  • Use macros to dynamically generate content based on category, product name, brand, image or any other field.
  • Apply a few prompts one by one to one field to get the best results (for example generate product description by parts and append generated data to get the best result).
  • Run multiple prompts for multiple products in bulk.
  • Get free assistance to adjust your prompt with our prompt engineers.
  • Review and approve changes before applying them to your live store.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress version 4.1.1 or higher
  • WooCommerce version 2.3.4 or higher
  • PHP version 5.4 or higher
  • MySQL version 5.0 or higher

Please note, this plugin is not a stand-alone product. It is used to set connections between the Store Manager for WooCommerce and your AI model.
If you still do not have Store Manager installed, download free trial by this link

Manual installation

The manual installation method involves downloading our plugin from our official site with further uploading it to your web server via WordPress backend or any FTP client.

Updating

After the new version of the plugin rolls out, you can easily update the plug-in from the backend. Version number and update button will be immediately displayed in the list of plugins.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of WooCommerce Store Manager Connector, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field, type “AI Data Generator with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Nano Banana 2, Ollama and LM Studio for WooCommerce” and click Search Plugins. Once you’ve found our plugin you can view details about it such as the point release, rating and description. Most importantly of course, you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.
